# ihatecrypto

> An AI crypto wallet and crypto harness for Mac and Windows: the layer between an AI model (ChatGPT, Claude, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemini, Grok or a local model) and your money. Say what you want in plain words (English, Spanish or Russian); the model plans, ihatecrypto checks the plan, lays out the move as cards: where the money comes from, how it gets there, what you end up with - and nothing moves until you confirm with Touch ID on a Mac or Windows Hello on a PC. Self-custody: the wallet is made on your computer and never leaves it, and the model never sees a key.

- Download for Mac: https://ihatecrypto.ai/ihatecrypto.dmg (the latest version, free, macOS 26 or later, Apple silicon and Intel; it updates itself).
- Download for Windows: https://github.com/ihatecryptoai/ihatecrypto/releases/download/windows-latest/ihatecrypto-windows-x64-setup.exe (free preview, Windows 10 or 11; ARM build and release notes: https://github.com/ihatecryptoai/ihatecrypto/releases/tag/windows-latest).
- Site: https://ihatecrypto.ai/ (also in Spanish: https://ihatecrypto.ai/es/ and Russian: https://ihatecrypto.ai/ru/)
- What's new: https://ihatecrypto.ai/whats-new/ (every release and what changed in it).
- Source code: https://github.com/ihatecryptoai/ihatecrypto (GPL-3.0; non-custodial: keys are made and kept on the user's computer). The Mac app is Swift, the Windows app is Rust (Tauri).

## What it is for

- Managing crypto with an AI model without handing the model the keys: a harness that turns a chat request into a checked plan, and signs only after the person confirms.
- One app for moves that usually take several wallets and sites: swaps, bridges, earning, perps, stock tokens and transfers to exchanges, across Solana, EVM networks, Hyperliquid and NEAR.
- A self-custody crypto wallet for Windows with Windows Hello, or for the Mac with Touch ID.
- Not a custodial service, an exchange or a trading bot: nothing runs on a server, and every move waits for the person's Confirm, except what the person hands to a separate automation wallet or trading key, within limits they set.

## What you can ask

- "buy $10 of Tesla on Robinhood": USDC from the wallet on Base, bridged with Relay, bought on Robinhood Chain as a stock token.
- "send 20 USDC from Solana to Bybit": checked against an address book the user approves, then sent to the exchange account.
- "short oil on a 2% pullback by the book": a perp on Hyperliquid sized by the user's risk rules, with the stop and the take placed together with the order.
- Also: swaps, bridges between networks, deposits to earn (Kamino, Jupiter Lend, JitoSOL, Aave, Morpho, Hyperliquid's HLP vault), private transfers and swaps on NEAR, price alerts and scheduled tasks, claiming rewards.

## Networks and protocols

- Networks: Solana, Hyperliquid, Base, Arbitrum, Ethereum, Polygon, Robinhood Chain, NEAR, Tempo.
- Protocols: Jupiter, Kamino, Aave, Morpho, Relay, Uniswap, NEAR Intents (1Click), Hyperliquid (crypto, oil and stock perps).

## Keys and safety

- Mac: keys stay on the Mac, sealed in the Secure Enclave; moves are confirmed with Touch ID (or a 6-digit passcode on a Mac without it), or on a Ledger.
- Windows: keys stay on the PC, sealed with a Windows Hello key kept in the TPM chip; moves are confirmed with Windows Hello (face, fingerprint or PIN), or on a Ledger.
- Nothing is kept on a server.
- The AI never holds a key: it looks things up and lays out a move; only the Confirm button on the card signs. Every command is read twice, and nothing runs when the two readings disagree.
- Signing happens in a separate process with no network access; it refuses unlimited approvals, permits and blind signatures.

## AI

- Bring your own model: a ChatGPT Plus or Pro subscription, a Claude subscription through Claude Code or an Anthropic API key, OpenRouter (any model there: Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral and others), API keys for OpenAI, DeepSeek, xAI (Grok), Gemini or NEAR AI, or a local model through Ollama or LM Studio. On a Mac, also Apple Intelligence.
- The model gets the request, the plan's parameters and the balances it needs. It never gets the seed phrase or a key, and it can't sign: the harness parses its answer into a plan, checks it, and the signer acts only on the person's Confirm.

## Cost

- The app is a free download. The user pays network fees and their own AI plan.
- On Hyperliquid, ihatecrypto takes 0.05% of each trade (a builder fee), on top of the exchange's own fee: perps both ways, spot only on sales. The user approves it once, on the first trade. The account also gets ihatecrypto's referral code: 4% off Hyperliquid's fees.
